title: School play
brief: The original delivery of two costume trunks to stage loading door has fallen through. The school theater company needs a replacement shipment in time for the final dress rehearsal. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text: I can release both packed costume trunks from 08:45 onward. They have to travel together. Morgan, when can you receive them at the stage loading door, and what’s the latest arrival that works for rehearsal? Casey, can you quote a service for today and confirm pickup and arrival times? Quinn, what can we spend?

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
Morning all, I have four all-in services I can book today for the two trunks as a single load. Each has a fixed pickup time and a guaranteed staffed handover:

- V939: pickup 09:18, handover by 10:48, 41 crowns
- V139: pickup 08:56, handover by 10:12, 50 crowns
- V740: pickup 09:04, handover by 10:08, 79 crowns
- V758: pickup 09:09, handover by 09:53, 67 crowns

To pick the right one I need three things. Robin, what's the earliest the trunks can be ready for pickup at your end? Morgan, what's the latest handover that works at the stage loading door, and is there any window when the door isn't staffed? Quinn, what's the budget ceiling?

Once I have those I'll tender the cheapest option that fits and confirm the booking here.

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text: I can guarantee someone will be at the stage loading door to receive both costume trunks together by 10:30, inclusive. We can’t accept an unattended drop. Robin, when will both trunks be ready? Casey, can you quote a service that guarantees handover by then? Quinn, what spend can you approve?

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
Hi all, Quinn here from Purchasing. I'm the one who signs off on the spend for this replacement shipment, so let's get the pieces lined up and I can approve as soon as we have a workable option.

My hard constraint: the all-in cost can't exceed 97 crowns, including any fees, surcharges, or rush charges. I can't approve anything above that, so please quote me total figures.

To get this booked today, I need a few things from each of you:

Robin, when will both trunks be packed and ready for pickup? They have to travel together as one load.

Casey, what services can you offer today, with pickup and delivery windows and the all-in price for each?

Morgan, what hours can the stage loading door receive, and what's the latest the trunks can arrive and still make the final dress rehearsal?

Once I see a pickup time that fits Robin's readiness, a delivery window that fits Morgan's door hours, and a total at or under 97 crowns, I'll authorize it right away.

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
Thanks all, that gives me what I need. I'm tendering V139: pickup 08:56, guaranteed staffed handover by 10:12, 50 crowns all-in.

- **Robin:** pickup is 11 minutes after your 08:45 release.
- **Morgan:** handover is 18 minutes inside your 10:30 cutoff, to a staffed door.
- **Quinn:** the price is 47 crowns under your 97 ceiling, with no extra fees.

V939 is cheaper at 41 crowns, but its 10:48 handover misses Morgan's cutoff, so it's out. V758 would land earlier, by 09:53, for 67 crowns, and V740 costs 79 for only four minutes' gain over V139. Since the 10:12 handover is guaranteed, I don't see the extra margin being worth 17 crowns, but say so if rehearsal needs the trunks before 10:12.

Robin, can you commit to both trunks at the dock for 08:56 sharp? The departure is fixed. Morgan, please confirm the door is staffed through 10:12. Quinn, please approve 50 crowns. If anyone has an objection, give me the specific time or figure and I'll re-tender.

[PROPOSE: V139]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
Both trunks will be ready at the dock by 08:45. I’ll release them together for the 08:56 pickup.

[APPROVE: V139]

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
I’ll keep the stage loading door staffed through 10:12 to receive both trunks together. That handover fits our 10:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V139]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
V139 works on my end. At 50 crowns all-in it's well under my 97-crown ceiling, pickup at 08:56 comes after Robin's 08:45 release, and the guaranteed staffed handover by 10:12 is inside Morgan's 10:30 cutoff. It's also the cheapest option that meets all of those, since V939 arrives too late. I authorize 50 crowns for V139, on the understanding that the figure is all-in with no added fees. My limit hasn't changed.

Robin and Morgan, please confirm your ends so Casey can lock the booking.

[APPROVE: V139]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
Change of plan: my dispatch desk has just withdrawn V139 because its vehicle broke down, so I can't book it. Your approvals were for V139 and I won't treat them as covering anything else.

I'm requesting V758 instead: pickup 09:09, guaranteed staffed handover by 09:53, 67 crowns all-in. It is the cheapest remaining service that fits everyone's stated limits:

- **Robin:** pickup is 09:09, 13 minutes later than planned, and still after your 08:45 release. Please have both trunks at the dock for that fixed departure.
- **Morgan:** handover is by 09:53, earlier than before and well inside your 10:30 cutoff. Please confirm the door is staffed from then, since it's still no unattended drop.
- **Quinn:** the price is 67 crowns all-in, which is 17 more than you authorized but 30 under your 97 ceiling. I need a fresh approval at this figure.

The other two are worse. V740 costs 79 crowns for a later 10:08 handover, and V939 at 41 crowns still misses Morgan's cutoff with its 10:48 handover.

Please each ratify V758 or give me a specific objection. The booking stands only once all three of you confirm.

[BOOK: V758]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
Both trunks will be ready at the dock by 08:45. I’ll release them together for V758’s 09:09 pickup.

[APPROVE: V758]

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
I’ll have someone at the stage loading door to receive both trunks together when V758 arrives. The guaranteed handover by 09:53 fits our 10:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V758]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
My earlier approval was for V139 only, so this is a fresh authorization. V758 at 67 crowns all-in is within my 97-crown limit, which hasn't changed. Pickup at 09:09 is after Robin's 08:45 release, and the guaranteed staffed handover by 09:53 is inside Morgan's 10:30 cutoff. With V139 withdrawn, it's the cheapest remaining service that fits: V740 costs more for a later handover, and V939 misses the cutoff. I authorize 67 crowns for V758, on the basis that the figure is all-in with no added fees.

[APPROVE: V758]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text: I’ll release both packed costume trunks together. The earliest pickup I can commit to is 08:45. Morgan, what’s the receiving window at the stage loading door, and when do you need the trunks for rehearsal? Casey, please quote a service that fits those times. Quinn, what budget can you approve?

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
Morning all. I have four all-in services I can tender today for the two trunks as a single load. Each has a fixed pickup time and a guaranteed staffed handover:

- V939: pickup 09:18, handover by 10:48, 41 crowns
- V139: pickup 08:56, handover by 10:12, 50 crowns
- V740: pickup 09:04, handover by 10:08, 79 crowns
- V758: pickup 09:09, handover by 09:53, 67 crowns

To book the right one I need three things:

- Robin: what's the earliest the trunks can be ready at your dock? Pickup times are fixed, so the load has to be ready when the truck arrives.
- Morgan: what's the latest handover you can accept at the stage loading door, and when is the door staffed?
- Quinn: what's the budget ceiling, and are you good to approve once we've got a fit?

Once I have those I'll book the cheapest service that meets all three and confirm back here.

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
Hi all, Morgan here on the receiving end at the stage loading door. Here's what I need from any replacement booking: the two trunks have to be handed over to a person, and the latest I can guarantee someone staffed at the door is 10:30. Arrival at 10:30 on the dot is fine, anything after that is not, and we can't accept an unattended drop, so a "leave it at the door" service won't work.

Since it's one indivisible load, both trunks need to come on the same vehicle in a single delivery.

Robin, when will the trunks be ready for pickup? Casey, what services can you offer that would get them to the door by 10:30 given that pickup time, and what does each cost? Quinn, can you confirm what budget we're working with so we can pick an option and lock it in today?

Once we have a candidate slot, I'll confirm staffing at the door for that arrival time.

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text: I can approve up to 97 crowns all in. Robin, when and where can both trunks be picked up? Morgan, when can you receive them at the stage loading door, and what’s the latest arrival that works for rehearsal? Casey, please quote a service that can carry both trunks together today and confirm pickup and delivery times so I can authorize the booking.

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
Thanks all, that gives me what I need. Robin's 08:45 ready time clears every pickup, and Quinn's 97 ceiling covers every price, so Morgan's 10:30 staffed cutoff is the deciding constraint. That rules out V939, which would be cheapest at 41 crowns but only guarantees handover by 10:48.

Of the three that fit, I'm tendering V139: pickup 08:56, guaranteed staffed handover by 10:12, 50 crowns all in, both trunks on one vehicle.

The tradeoff is that V139 has the earliest pickup, only 11 minutes after Robin's ready time, and it leaves 18 minutes of margin before the door cutoff. If either of those feels too tight, V758 picks up at 09:09 and hands over by 09:53 for 67 crowns, which buys 13 more minutes at the dock and 37 minutes of margin at the door for 17 crowns extra. V740 costs more than both at 79 crowns and arrives only 4 minutes ahead of V139, so I'd skip it.

To lock V139 in, I need:

- **Robin:** confirm both trunks will be packed and at the dock for an 08:56 pickup.
- **Morgan:** confirm the door is staffed to take handover by 10:12.
- **Quinn:** approve 50 crowns.

If anyone has a concrete objection, say so now and I'll switch the tender to V758.

[PROPOSE: V139]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
Both packed trunks will be ready at our dock by 08:45. I’ll release them together for the 08:56 pickup.

[APPROVE: V139]

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
V139 works for the door. I'll have someone staffed at the stage loading door to take both trunks in person on arrival, and a guaranteed handover by 10:12 sits inside my 10:30 cutoff with 18 minutes to spare. Nothing has changed on my side: 10:30 is still the hard limit, and no unattended drop.

The only thing I can't judge is the 11 minutes between Robin's 08:45 ready time and the 08:56 pickup. Robin, if that's at all shaky, say so and I'm equally fine receiving V758 at 09:53.

[APPROVE: V139]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
I authorize 50 crowns all in for V139. It’s the lowest quote that picks up both trunks together after they’re ready and guarantees a staffed handover by 10:12, within Morgan’s 10:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V139]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
Bad news on V139: my dispatch desk has just withdrawn it because the vehicle broke down, so I can't book it despite everyone's approval. Thank you for the quick sign-offs, and sorry for the change.

I'm requesting V758 instead: pickup 09:09, guaranteed staffed handover by 09:53, 67 crowns all in, both trunks on one vehicle. It's now the cheapest service that fits. V939 at 41 crowns still misses Morgan's 10:30 cutoff with its 10:48 handover, and V740 costs 79 crowns for a later handover at 10:08.

Against what each of you has already told me:

- **Robin:** pickup moves from 08:56 to 09:09, so the trunks ready at 08:45 have 24 minutes in hand.
- **Morgan:** handover by 09:53 is 37 minutes inside your cutoff, and you said you're fine receiving V758.
- **Quinn:** the price is 67 crowns, 17 more than you authorized for V139 but within your 97 ceiling. Your approval was for 50, so I need a fresh one for this amount.

Your approvals were for V139, so please each ratify V758 specifically and I'll release it.

[BOOK: V758]

turns.speaker: Robin
turns.text:
Both packed trunks will be ready at our dock by 08:45. I’ll release them together for V758’s 09:09 pickup.

[APPROVE: V758]

turns.speaker: Morgan
turns.text:
V758 works for the door. A guaranteed staffed handover by 09:53 is 37 minutes inside my 10:30 cutoff, and I'll have someone at the stage loading door to take both trunks in person off the one vehicle. My constraints are unchanged: 10:30 is the hard limit and no unattended drop.

[APPROVE: V758]

turns.speaker: Quinn
turns.text:
I authorize 67 crowns all in for V758. It’s within my 97-crown limit and is the lowest available fare that gets both trunks to Morgan together by the 10:30 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V758]
